( @Pappajevel ) Maybe shouldn't have more than ONE kid on closer thought... 
( @Wiz|wrk ) once up there it was pretty nice, and I was struck by a strange sexual daydream, since the actress playing Pippi in the shows was really fucking hot.. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) at 18:00 the theme park closes and we start heading to the car. when all the kids and all the various luggage are loaded we head home. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) since we drove together with some acquaintances there are now 2 cars heading south from Vimmerby when we get the idea to swing by Lönneberga and Katthult to see Emil's "real" house. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) For those of you not versed in Småland I can inform you that Lönneberga is in the middle of nowhere and Katthult is even further out. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) 2 km after Lönneberga (the bump in the road) there the car dies.... 
(@Wiz|wrk ) at 20:00 on a Saturday evening we're standing there with a car full of kids and tired parents that refuse to start... 
( @Wiz|wrk ) After 15 minutes of hobby comments I conclude it must be the fuel pump that's given up. to investigate further we empty the whole trunk in search of the pump. It's found after 20 min and one stopped saab later. (we had no tools and everyone who drives a saab knows that Saab + Torx screwdriver = true 
( @Wiz|wrk ) all the contacts look fine but the pump is as dead as Glenn the first. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) well... 
( @Wiz|wrk ) what to do? 
( @Wiz|wrk ) 23 mil home, the clock approaching 21 
( @Wiz|wrk ) 2 kids + partner + 1 broken car bastard + Småland forest + loneliness 
( @Wezz|Wrk ) go amish and live happily for the rest of your lives 
( @Wiz|wrk ) the buddy's parents 8 mil away have been notified and are setting out on a rescue mission. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) 1 hour later their dad shows up and says a bit shakily that 1 km ago he had to slam the brakes for a deer.. when he did that he stopped the car right by an entrance to the only building within a couple hundred meters (the outskirts of Lönneberga) The sign says "JP Bilmek" 
( @Wiz|wrk ) With this information I throw myself in his car and blast off to the lovely workshop.. I'm there around 22:30. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) get there and there are people standing there?! I stroll in expecting to get beaten to death by the two natives.. (you've all seen that movie where "the inbreeds hunt burt reynolds") 
( @Wiz|wrk ) After presenting my problem and hoping the locals will understand what I'm saying the guy answers in pitch-perfect Småland dialect and with a clear ring of entrepreneurial spirit that we'll tow the car down to them so they can "have a look at it" 
( @Wiz|wrk ) after leaving the car there and riding with the buddies to his in-laws' cabin, the inbreeds throw themselves over my white saab. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) at 10 on Sunday morning the phone rings and the farmhand-fucker has fixed the car during the night and morning. 
( @Wiz|wrk ) the guy has siphoned out all the fuel, torn down the tank, pulled out the pump, torn it apart, driven to a scrapyard 5 mil away, unscrewed a pump from a saab 900, (I drive an old 9000) seen that this one should probably fit, modified the 900 pump with some parts from the old one, wired and fiddled, mounted the tank back and siphoned all the petrol back in. DURING THE NIGHT AND MORNING... 
( @Wiz|wrk ) stunned by the shock I ask what I owe... 1500 :- 
( @Wiz|wrk ) today I'm gonna go buy a lotto ticket, because with all the bad luck of the fuel pump breaking down you really can't have more luck on so many points... 
( @Wiz|wrk ) where the hell can you get your car fixed on a Saturday night ... FOR FIFTEEN HUNDRED BUCKS ?!

<niohundra> Moved into the new apartment today. Hooked up the home phone and iternet 2 hours ago. Sat right down and checked the mail and paid the bills. 
<niohundra> It took barely fifteen minutes after I'd hooked up everything, until some girl from comhem calls, on my home number, and asks why I have telephony and broadband, but not tv from them. "Because you just have to have it!" 
<niohundra> I politely replied that I had a Boxer with a twin card that costs me about zero kronor a month.  
<niohundra> Then when she was saying goodbye and sounded sour about not getting to sell anything I put her to the test.  
<niohundra> "Oh by the way, can you check something for me. I moved into the new apartment today, and just hooked up the phone. Could you check that it and my broadband work at this address?" 
<niohundra> She answers "Uhh, yeah maybe. Let me see here. Yeah unfortunately it's like this. There's been a bit of a clash, so your home phone and your internet won't work until Monday." 
<niohundra> It absolutely reeks of competence.
sv:
<niohundra> Flyttade in i nya lägenheten idag. Kopplade in hemtelefon och iternet för 2 timmar sen. Satte mig direkt och kollade mailen och betalade räkningarna. 
<niohundra> Det tog knappt en kvart efter jag kopplat in allt, tills att nån tjej från comhem ringer, på mitt hemnummer, och frågar varför jag har telefoni och bredband, men inte tv från dem. "För det måste du ju bara ha!" 
<niohundra> Jag svarade vänligt att jag hade en boxer med tvillingkort som kostar mig ungefär noll kronor i månaden.  
<niohundra> Sen när hon skulle säga hejdå och lät sur för att hon inte fick sälja nåt satte jag henne på prov.  
<niohundra> "Du förresten, kan du kolla en sak åt mig. Jag flyttade in i nya lägenheten idag, och kopplade precis in telefonen. Skulle du kunna kolla så att den och mitt bredband fungerar på den här adressen?" 
<niohundra> Hon svarar "Ehh, ja kanske. Ska se här. Jo det är tyvärr såhär. Det har det krockat lite, så din hemtelefon och ditt internet kommer inte fungera förrän på måndag." 
<niohundra> Det fullkomligt stinker kompetens.
